questions.question: MICROSCOPE : CELL :: TELESCOPE : ?
questions.explanation: A microscope is used to examine a cell; similarly, a telescope is used to examine a star. The analogy is tool to object.
steps: 1. Identify the relationship: microscope examines cell.
3. Eliminate: Earth (too broad), Lens (part of tool), Distance (abstract).
questions.fastStrategy: Microscope:Cell :: Telescope:Star (both tools examine small/distant objects).

questions.question: AUTHOR : BOOK :: ARCHITECT : ?
questions.explanation: An author creates a book; similarly, an architect creates a building. The analogy is creator to creation.
steps: 1. Identify the relationship: author creates book (creator to creation).
3. Evaluate: Blueprint (planning tool), Structure (abstract), Building (tangible creation), Design (process).
4. Building is the most direct parallel.
